entities.summary: William Tierney Clark FRS FRAS was an English civil engineer particularly associated with the design and construction of bridges. He was among the earliest designers of suspension bridges. William Tierney Clark was a architects & engineers from Bristol (1783-08-23, Bristol–1852-09-22). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
